Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the very first step by stating in the "Updated Understanding" section that "Joe D'Amato died in 1999". This was an assumption not supported by the search results available at that time (the search results confirmed the director's name and the film details but did not display the death year). By inserting this incorrect fact as established knowledge before verifying it with a source, the Planner set up a false premise. Consequently, when the WebSurfer later retrieved the correct data (confirming Joe D'Amato died in 1999), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the comparison logic in the final step. Because the Planner had already assumed Joe D'Amato died in 1999, and the Planner later claimed Thomas Carr died in 1997, the Planner's internal logic incorrectly concluded that 1997 was "later" than 1999, leading to the wrong final answer (Hostile Country) instead of the correct one (Emanuelle And The Last Cannibals).
